analysis:
Examined base_text units of CHANGELOG.md lines 809-1242. These are unchanged historical release notes. Per file_changes (range_map_complete=true), the only changed ranges are base 11-13 and head 11-39: a new v0.10.10 candidate section describing `darkbloom waitlist` and approval gating for new sandbox/cluster setups. Those changed lines are not in these units except via the truncated patch excerpt.

The documentation-only content in the supplied units restates pre-existing behavior. It covers cluster prefix SSD tiers (T-041 scope: per-boundary records, `balanced` precision, scoping by artifact/build/MTP policy), rollback/quarantine (T-043), sandbox setup running the downloaded installer with `--plan` (TB-013/T-061), and App Attest lease status display (TB-011/T-057). No new security-relevant change is introduced there.

The patch excerpt describes waitlist approval gating. It says existing setups are never re-asked and "if the coordinator does not offer waitlists yet, both new setups go on as in 0.[9]", which is a fail-open on coordinator absence. That is an availability/business gate, not a security control in the threat model, and no source implementation was supplied. Integration should check: (1) whether the waitlist approval is enforced coordinator-side rather than only in the CLI, since the CLI is operator-controlled (ADV-001, TB-003); (2) whether the new waitlist endpoint uses A-008 tokens appropriately; and (3) whether TB-013/T-061 need updating for the new pre-setup network call.

No regression is identified in these units.
